items.stem: What is the remainder when 324 children are divided into coaches that can seat 14 children each?
If 12 × 20 = 240, which of the following is also true?
What is 440 ÷ 22?
What is 11 × 200?
If a sack of rice weighs 100 kg, how many sacks are needed for 600 kg of rice?
If 64 people can be seated in one boat, how many boats are needed for 960 participants?
What is the cost of the ticket in the passage?
If 10 kg of rice is packed in one sack, how many sacks are needed for 6000 kg of rice?
Which child will not receive any change from the cashier?
If each aeroplane can carry 30 people, how many people can 5 aeroplanes carry?
If the cost of the ticket is Rs 7 and Chinnu has only coins of Rs 5, how many coins will she need to pay, and will she get any change?
Which child has all the notes of the same denomination?
If the ticket cost is Rs 10, which child will not receive any change?
What is the cost of the ticket that the five friends are trying to buy?
Based on the pattern in the multiplications, which of the following will also follow the same pattern?
If the cost of the ticket is Rs 10 and the cashier takes 10 seconds to count one coin, how long will it take to count Chinnu’s coins?
If the ticket cost is Rs 20 and Bujji has only Rs 10 notes, how many notes will he need to buy the ticket?
How many people can be seated in 12 buses if each bus can seat 20 people?
How many coaches will be needed for 324 children if each coach can seat 14 children?
What is 10 × 10?

What is 3 × 100?
What is 10 × 10 in terms of tens?
Which of the following represents 16 × 10 in terms of tens?
If each coach can seat 14 children and there are 15 coaches, how many children can be seated in total?
